parsed_profile.title: 7FA TURBINE SHELL INLET BLEED HEAT (IBH) EXTRACTION PIPE WELD CRACKING
parsed_profile.reason_for_revision: The purpose of revision is to provide recommended inspection intervals and update the affected unit list and application to include 7F, 7FA and 7FA+.
parsed_profile.purpose: To recommend inspection of 7FA turbine shell IBH extraction port cover flange pipes for potential weld cracking, and to specify corrective action if required.
parsed_profile.compliance_category_text: Safety - Failure to comply with this TIL could result in personal injury. Compliance is mandated within a specific operating time.
parsed_profile.recurring_indicator_if_found: Yes - Re-inspection at every HGPI/Major inspection, or at a convenient planned outage
scope_of_work: Dye penetrant inspection of the IBH extraction port cover flange pipe weld joint by a certified level II NDT inspector
If cracks found: Option 1 - Grind off cracked section and perform repair welding per GE weld specification P8A-AG3 or equivalent
If cracks found: Option 2 - Replace the flange with a new part and new flange gasket, install per MLI-0705 assembly drawing
Re-inspect repaired, replaced, and original IBH weld joints per recommended schedule
service_recommendation_line_items: Perform dye penetrant inspection of IBH extraction port cover flange pipe weld joint at first HGPI; if beyond first HGPI, then at next planned shutdown opportunity
Re-inspect at every HGPI/Major inspection, or at a convenient planned outage
If cracks found, perform repair by grinding off cracked section and weld repair per P8A-AG3 or equivalent, OR replace flange with new part per MLI-0705
A new flange gasket is required if replacement option is chosen
Re-inspect repaired, replaced, and original IBH weld joints per the same schedule
All personnel must remain outside the gas turbine compartment while the gas turbine is fired and running, unless absolutely necessary
parsed_profile.completion_criteria_text: Dye penetrant inspection completed by certified NDT level II inspector per SNT-TC-1A with no indications, or corrective action (repair or replacement) completed and re-inspected.

source_snippets.snippet: To recommend inspection of 7FA turbine shell IBH extraction port cover flange pipes for potential weld cracking, and to specify corrective action if required.
The crack initiated at the pipe to cover flange weld as shown in Figure 2, and resulted in substantial hot air leakage.
This type of leakage can cause elevated turbine compartment temperatures that could lead to a forced outage condition, and are also a safety concern.
GE recommends dye penetrant inspection of the weld joint by a certified level II NDT inspector
First inspection at the first Hot Gas Path inspection (HGPI). If beyond first HGPI, then at the next planned shutdown opportunity.
Estimated time to complete: 2 hours for NDT inspection, after unit is shut down and all safety requirements are implemented. 1 Shift to remove the flanges and repair the weld.
Replace the flange with a new part. A new flange gasket will also be required. Install per the MLI-0705 assembly drawing.
